_comment_overview: Default configuration template for cloudflare-ddns-service. Copy to config.json for local use or let CI populate from the DDNS_ZONE_MAP repository variable.
_comment_zone_map: Maps each permitted root domain (no leading dot) to its 32-character Cloudflare Zone ID. The keys of this object also serve as the allowed domains whitelist, and the first key is used as the primary domain in CI smoke tests.
_comment_block_list: Array of forbidden leftmost hostname labels (subdomains) that can never be created or updated via DDNS, even if a user has a wildcard suffix rule.
_comment_allow_creation: If true, creates a new A/AAAA DNS record when an authorized hostname does not yet exist in the Cloudflare zone. If false, only updates existing records.
_comment_default_ttl: DNS Time-To-Live in seconds for created/updated A and AAAA records (60 is Cloudflare's minimum non-proxied TTL; 1 = Automatic).
_comment_default_proxied: Whether newly created or updated DDNS records have Cloudflare proxy (orange cloud) enabled by default. Should almost always be false for router/VPN DDNS.
_comment_allow_ipv6_auto_clear: When true, if a client explicitly sends an IPv4 update with an empty ipv6= parameter (e.g. ipv6=), any stale AAAA record on that hostname is automatically deleted.
_comment_rate_limit_max_fails: Maximum failed authentication or PIN onboarding attempts allowed from a single client IP before temporary blocking kicks in.
_comment_rate_limit_window_sec: Sliding time window (in seconds) during which failed attempts are counted before resetting.
_comment_rate_limit_block_sec: Base duration (in seconds) that a client IP is blocked in KV after exceeding rate_limit_max_fails (3600 = 1 hour).
_comment_penalty_type: Backoff strategy for repeated lockouts: 'fixed' (always rate_limit_block_sec) or 'logarithmic' (scales up toward max_penalty_sec on repeat offenses).
_comment_max_penalty_sec: Maximum lockout cap (in seconds) when penalty_type is set to 'logarithmic' (3600000 = ~41.6 days).
_comment_max_zone_records: Safety ceiling on total DNS records in a zone before refusing automatic record creation (prevents runaway wildcard abuse).
_comment_alert_webhook_url: Optional HTTPS webhook URL (Discord/Slack/ntfy) to POST security alerts when an IP is locked out or onboarding occurs. Leave empty string to disable.
